title: Hypnotic regression reveals mental contact with the creature
place_text: Crash site near Varginha; regression at a beach, Brazil

tellings.difference: Carlos tells it firsthand, says he saw the tape himself, and gives none of what the creature said.
tellings.link_reason: Carlos says he believes what telling 1 reports because he saw the tape of that same regression session.

as_told.title: Carlos sees recording of his own regression session

plain: A hypnosis session held at a beach in Brazil is said to have brought back a witness's memory of reaching out to a creature at a crash site near the town of Varginha in 1996. The creature supposedly spoke into the witness's mind: "Calm down. Everything is fine. Go away. It's dangerous for you here." The session used regression hypnosis, a method that tries to recover buried memories, and it was filmed. A man named Carlos de Souza tells this on Michels's episode about an alien said to have been treated in a Brazilian hospital, reading from the recording. He says he believes it "because I saw the tape", which, if true, would mean the creature talked to people without speaking aloud.
